description.narrative: Support with advocacy actions to Christian Aid and its partners in Colombia, based on the objectives set within the Irish Aid ICSP Program, such as: · Support the CA Colombian partners in advocacy actions and statements in national and intergovernmental strategic bodies, on protection, prevention of human rights violations and peace building. · Support land rights defenders taking action to advocate for their rights at local, national and international level. · Coordinated campaigns with civil society and victims' movements and platforms (especially with ICSP CA Colombian partners), both nationally and internationally, to promote protection and stop stigmatization and aggression against human rights defenders, particularly women and land right defenders. · International advocacy work directed at institutions such as the UN, the EU, embassies, the Inter-American Human Rights System and foreign governments, among others, in order that rights holders (women, men, groups, organisations, communities and peoples) take action to advance their rights. · Support advocacy actions that promote and encourage policies and strategies that enable rural populations that are being affected by conflict, climate change and/or displacement to strengthen their capacities and abilities to adapt and become resilient to the adverse and severe impact of climate change. · Organize public events, human rights defenders' tours, field visits with public officials or members of the UK and Irish Parliaments and joint advocacy meetings to raise the profile of human rights defenders, particularly women and environmental
